source.scope: Dates and resolution identifiers follow the 3 July 2026 depositary list. Numbered Word paragraphs identify source rows including empty paragraphs. PDF links use physical status-book pages. The books and State workbook are separate editions dated 30 October 2026. Treaty dates describe the instrument internationally. Individual State dates, declarations, and domestic implementation can differ.

participation.scope: The workbook records ratification or accession (x) and denunciation (d) as at its stated date. Blank cells and unlisted territories provide no affirmative record here. The status books give individual dates, declarations and territorial extensions.
